en.meta.title: Social Security Number Upload Guide
en.page.title: How to upload your Social Security Number
en.page.intro: Having trouble with the Social Security step in the app? Follow the steps below — each numbered marker on the screenshots shows exactly what to tap or fill in.
en.step1.title: Go to the Document section
en.step1.body: In the registration app, open the Document section. You'll see a card labeled Social Security...
en.step2.title: Tap Social Security and fill in the details
en.step2.body: Tap the Social Security card to open the form, then follow the numbered markers below in order.
en.step3.title: Find your Social Security Number
en.step3.body: Not sure where to look? Your number is printed on your Social Security card, as shown below. Marker 3 matches the same number from the form in step 2.
en.step3.caption: Sample Social Security card — the 9-digit number is near the top
en.step4.title: Save
en.step4.body: Once your photo and number are both entered, tap Save (marker 4 in step 2). Your Social Security step is now complete.
en.legend.tap: Tap this card to open the Social Security form.
en.legend.upload: Tap here to upload a clear photo of yourself — this is a photo of you, not of a document.
en.legend.docnum: Type your 9-digit Social Security Number here.
en.legend.save: Tap Save once everything looks correct.
en.tips.title: Before you save
en.tips.item1: Use a clear, recent photo of yourself — good lighting, no sunglasses or hats, and your face fully visible.
en.tips.item2: Double-check your 9-digit Social Security Number before saving — it must be entered correctly for your tax forms to process.
en.tips.item3: Your Social Security Number is sensitive personal information — only enter it on a private, secure connection.
en.footer.help: Still having trouble? Contact support from within the app for further assistance.
